verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a local HTTP API running on localhost (offline-capable), a CLI that can run Anytype as a headless server for scripting/automation, and a gRPC API plus documented MCP server for programmatic access — all directly supporting driving the app from outside scripts. missing for 10: explicit URI-scheme/deep-link support, and independent/hands-on confirmation that the local API/CLI actually work as documented in real workflows.
